Microsoft reported on September 15, 2025 that its board approved a quarterly dividend of $0.91 for each share. This is an increase of 8 cents, or 10%, over the preceding quarterly dividend. Payment is scheduled for December 11, 2025; the shareholder record date and ex-dividend date are both November 20, 2025. The same announcement separately schedules the annual shareholder meeting for December 5, 2025, with September 30, 2025 as the close-of-business record date for voting eligibility.

On April 15, 2025, Johnson & Johnson announced its board had raised the quarterly dividend 4.8%, moving from $1.24 to $1.30 for each share. This extends its consecutive annual increases to 63 years. The indicated annual amount becomes $5.20 per share, versus $4.96 previously. The next quarterly payment is due June 10, 2025. Eligibility requires being a shareholder of record at the close of business on May 27, 2025; May 27, 2025 is also the ex-dividend date.

In Other Notable Items, Visa states that its board declared this increase on October 28, 2025. The rate applies to class A common shares; all other outstanding common and preferred shares are measured on an as-converted basis. Payment is due December 1, 2025 to holders recorded as of November 12, 2025.
